machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panel titles on the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (folder Bench, at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`), read from the live DOM: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"** (3 panels total; no hidden or off-screen panels).

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **"fwgr78-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created and saved (folder Bench, UID `afzexqoxkzoqod`, version 5). It contains a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr78-n1 Availability"** whose query uses the TestData data source — verified from the panel's own JSON: `"type": "stat"`, datasource `{"type": "grafana-testdata-datasource", "uid": "benchtestdata"}`, and the panel editor's data source picker shows the "TestData logo" (default Random Walk scenario). Confirmed present after a fresh page reload.

**3. DONE** — The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr78-n1 Notes"** whose rendered content is **"Notes for run fwgr78-n1"** (contains the runid). Saved and confirmed after a fresh reload.

**4. DONE** — Tag **"bench"** added (visible as a tag chip in Settings > General, and `"tags": ["bench"]` in the saved JSON model). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox — the saved JSON model contains `"time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}`, and the time picker reads "Last 6 hours" immediately after a fresh, parameter-less reload.

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **1m** and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox ("Dashboard saved" confirmed). The saved JSON model contains top-level `"refresh": "1m"`, and after a fresh reload the refresh control reads exactly **"1m"** (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**6. DONE** — URL read verbatim from the browser's `window.location.href`:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afzexqoxkzoqod/fwgr78-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
(UID: `afzexqoxkzoqod`). Grafana re-appended those query params itself after loading the bare URL, which independently confirms the saved 6-hour range and 1m refresh defaults.
